name: desktop
description: Concentus desktop shell — supervises the backend and hosts its UI in a window.
//author: Not decoration: a .deb carries a Maintainer field and refuses to build without a name and an email, and the deb target is what failed the first Linux release for want of them.
//desktopName: Links running windows to the .desktop entry on Linux; without it the taskbar treats the app as unknown.

scripts.//package: --publish never because the release workflow uploads the artifacts itself; without it electron-builder publishes implicitly whenever it sees a git tag, which would race the workflow for the same release.
scripts.package: pnpm build && pnpm payload && electron-builder --publish never
